workflow_rationale: This is a single-service feature addition that extends existing brand-check.py with report generation. Using 'feature' workflow because we're adding new functionality in a staged manner: first data structures, then output formats, then historical tracking.

phases.name: Core Report Data Structures
phases.description: Add report data structures and aggregation logic to collect compliance metrics

subtasks.description: Add ComplianceReport class to aggregate findings

verification.command: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts'); from brand_check import ComplianceReport; print('OK')" 2>&1 || echo 'IMPORT_ERROR'

subtasks.implementation_notes: Create ComplianceReport class with fields: total_files, pass_count, fail_count, findings_by_category, severity_counts, top_violations, per_file_results, scan_timestamp

subtasks.description: Add --report flag and report aggregation logic
subtasks.implementation_notes: Add --report flag parsing in main(), aggregate findings across all files into ComplianceReport object

phases.name: JSON Report Generation
phases.description: Generate compliance reports in JSON format

verification.command: python3 scripts/brand-check.py index.html --report --format json --output /tmp/test-report.json 2>&1 && test -f /tmp/test-report.json && python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('/tmp/test-report.json'))" && echo 'OK' || echo 'FAIL'

subtasks.implementation_notes: Add to_json() method to ComplianceReport, add --format and --output flags, ensure JSON is valid and includes all required fields

verification.command: python3 scripts/brand-check.py index.html --report --format html --output /tmp/test-report.html 2>&1 && test -f /tmp/test-report.html && grep -q '<html' /tmp/test-report.html && echo 'OK' || echo 'FAIL'

subtasks.implementation_notes: Add to_html() method to ComplianceReport. Use inline CSS (no external dependencies) following index.html pattern. Include: summary stats, severity distribution chart, violations by category, top 5 violations, per-file breakdown with expandable details

verification.command: python3 scripts/brand-check.py index.html --report --format markdown --output /tmp/test-report.md 2>&1 && test -f /tmp/test-report.md && grep -q '##' /tmp/test-report.md && echo 'OK' || echo 'FAIL'

subtasks.implementation_notes: Add to_markdown() method to ComplianceReport. Include: heading hierarchy, tables for stats, code blocks for details, emoji/unicode for severity indicators

phases.name: Historical Tracking & Trends
phases.description: Store historical reports and generate trend data

subtasks.description: Add report storage to reports/ directory

verification.command: python3 scripts/brand-check.py index.html --report --format json --output reports/test-$(date +%s).json 2>&1 && test -d reports && ls reports/*.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'OK' || echo 'FAIL'

subtasks.implementation_notes: Auto-create reports/ directory, save with timestamp-based filenames (YYYY-MM-DD-HHmmss format), add --save-history flag

subtasks.description: Add trend analysis comparing current vs historical reports

verification.command: python3 scripts/brand-check.py index.html --report --format json --with-trends --output /tmp/test-trends.json 2>&1 && grep -q 'trend' /tmp/test-trends.json && echo 'OK' || echo 'FAIL'

subtasks.implementation_notes: Add --with-trends flag that loads previous reports from reports/ directory, calculates deltas (violations increasing/decreasing), includes trend data in all output formats

phases.name: Integration & Verification
phases.description: Verify all report formats work correctly with real data

subtasks.description: End-to-end verification of all report formats

steps: Run brand-check.py --report on entire repo in JSON format
Run brand-check.py --report on entire repo in HTML format
Run brand-check.py --report on entire repo in markdown format
Run brand-check.py --report with --with-trends on entire repo
Verify JSON is valid and complete
Verify HTML renders correctly in browser
Verify report generation completes in under 30 seconds for 100 files

subtasks.implementation_notes: Comprehensive test of all features with real repository data

verification.instructions: Run 'python3 scripts/brand-check.py --help' and verify all new flags are documented clearly

subtasks.implementation_notes: Update module docstring with usage examples for --report, --format, --output, --with-trends, --save-history flags

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Sequential execution required due to dependencies
parallelism.reasoning: Each phase depends on the previous phase completing. Phase 1 builds data structures, Phase 2 adds JSON, Phase 3 adds HTML (needs JSON), Phase 4 adds markdown, Phase 5 adds historical tracking, Phase 6 integrates everything.

acceptance_criteria: All existing brand-check.py tests pass (no regression)
Reports generate in all three formats (JSON, HTML, markdown)
HTML reports are self-contained with no external dependencies
Historical tracking stores and retrieves reports correctly
Trend analysis shows deltas between current and previous reports
Report generation completes in under 30 seconds for 100 files

verification_steps.name: JSON Report
verification_steps.command: python3 scripts/brand-check.py index.html --report --format json --output /tmp/test.json && python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('/tmp/test.json'))"

verification_strategy.reasoning: Medium risk because we're extending an existing CLI tool. Main risks: breaking existing functionality, performance degradation, file I/O errors. Mitigation: comprehensive command tests for each format, performance test, no changes to existing check logic.

checks: All sections visible (summary, violations, per-file details)
Report files are valid (JSON parseable, HTML valid, markdown well-formed)
